name: Dismounted Rifle Squad

placement_rationale.text: Sited at 1.6 km — inside doctrine.md §2's "control of the lower sky" bracket (1-1.5 km with local air/drone superiority, ~7 km without), the sourced finding that whichever side holds the lower airspace over its own trenches sets how close dismounted troops can actually operate, not doctrine or preference. Real reporting on 2024-2025 infantry tactics confirms the practical effect: units now move and fight in smaller, more dispersed sub-groups specifically because 24-hour drone coverage makes any above-ground movement visible within minutes.

short_role: The human element every other marker on this map ultimately supports or targets — the infantry actually holding or contesting ground at the line.
characteristics: Operates in small, dispersed sub-groups rather than a massed formation — the direct tactical response to persistent overhead drone coverage
Moves mainly at night or in short, covered rushes between positions
Organic short-range air defense (MANPADS, small arms) and its own FPV/recon drones increasingly supplement or replace calls for supporting fire
The most under-represented layer on this map until Pass 18 — every other asset exists to support, resupply, defend, or evacuate this one
employment_notes: Represents a generic Russian rifle squad holding or contesting a section of the line — not a specific named unit. Splits into an entry/assault element, a fire-support element suppressing the objective, and a reserve held back to organize defense or repel a counterattack, per documented 2024-2025 Ukrainian infantry tactics. Movement between positions is timed around drone-coverage gaps rather than tactical convenience.
contrast_vs_traditional: Traditional infantry maneuver massed troops for a coordinated assault or held a continuous manned line. Persistent overhead drone coverage on both sides has made any concentration of troops a target within minutes of forming, so units now fight dispersed by default — smaller sub-groups, longer gaps between positions, and movement scheduled around when the sky is actually watched rather than around when the mission needs it.

connections.description: Covered by counter-drone fire while moving between positions.
